info.name: SmartNotes AI - Complete REST API Collection
info.description:
Production-grade Postman collection for SmartNotes AI Android App backend (PHP + MySQL on XAMPP).

Works with Android frontend (Emulator 10.0.2.2 or Physical Device LAN IP).

body.raw:
{
  "note_id": {{note_id}},
  "title": "Database Normalization Mastery Quiz",
  "subject": "Computer Science",
  "difficulty": "Moderate",
  "question_type": "MCQ",
  "service_used": "SmartNotes AI Engine",
  "questions": [
    {
      "question_number": 1,
      "question_text": "Which change is required to bring a 1NF relation into 2NF?",
      "topic": "Normal Forms",
      "option_a": "Store multiple values in one cell",
      "option_b": "Remove partial dependencies on a composite key",
      "option_c": "Remove all transitive dependencies",
      "option_d": "Merge every relation into one table",
      "correct_option": "B",
      "explanation": "Every non-key attribute must depend on the whole candidate key, eliminating partial dependencies."
    },
    {
      "question_number": 2,
      "question_text": "What characterizes Third Normal Form (3NF)?",
      "topic": "Transitive Dependency",
      "option_a": "It allows non-key attributes to determine other non-key attributes",
      "option_b": "It requires repeating groups in columns",
      "option_c": "It is in 2NF and has no transitive dependencies between non-key attributes",
      "option_d": "It eliminates primary keys completely",
      "correct_option": "C",
      "explanation": "3NF requires a relation to be in 2NF with no transitive dependency between non-key attributes."
    },
    {
      "question_number": 3,
      "question_text": "What type of anomaly occurs when deleting a record inadvertently removes other unrelated data?",
      "topic": "Data Anomalies",
      "option_a": "Insertion anomaly",
      "option_b": "Update anomaly",
      "option_c": "Deletion anomaly",
      "option_d": "Serialization anomaly",
      "correct_option": "C",
      "explanation": "A deletion anomaly occurs when deleting certain data causes the unintended loss of other valuable data."
    },
    {
      "question_number": 4,
      "question_text": "If functional dependency X -> Y holds, what does this mathematically mean?",
      "topic": "Functional Dependency",
      "option_a": "Each value of X determines exactly one value of Y",
      "option_b": "Each value of Y determines multiple values of X",
      "option_c": "X and Y must be identical columns",
      "option_d": "X must always be null",
      "correct_option": "A",
      "explanation": "A functional dependency X -> Y means each value of X uniquely determines a single value of Y."
    },
    {
      "question_number": 5,
      "question_text": "Why are atomic values strictly required in First Normal Form (1NF)?",
      "topic": "1NF Atomicity",
      "option_a": "To increase storage requirements",
      "option_b": "To prevent multivalued and repeating groups in single attributes",
      "option_c": "To force using JSON strings only",
      "option_d": "To disable foreign key indexing",
      "correct_option": "B",
      "explanation": "1NF requires each column attribute value to be atomic (indivisible) with no repeating groups."
    }
  ]
}
